'''Imarel''' is one of the religions of [[Andah]]. Its principal denominations include [[Imarel Suun]], [[Rhov]], [[Tavessi]], [[Zovael Karesh]], [[Selvaeth]] and [[Thurvael]].

* [[Thurvael]]
